description: This file manages typing indicators in Feishu via reactions, including adding/removing reactions, handling API errors, and backoff logic.

classes.name: FeishuBackoffError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating a backoff condition from Feishu API, carrying a numeric code.

methods.name: isFeishuBackoffError
methods.description: Determines if an error is a rate-limit or quota-exceeded error from Feishu API.

methods.name: getBackoffCodeFromResponse
methods.description: Extracts backoff error code from a Feishu SDK response object.

methods.name: addTypingIndicator
methods.description: Adds a typing indicator reaction to a message, handling backoff errors and logging.

methods.name: removeTypingIndicator
methods.description: Removes a typing indicator reaction from a message, handling backoff errors and logging.
